## What changes?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue when applicable.

## How was it checked?

List the checks you actually ran and their results. For camera changes, include any real-device checks and the capture mode used.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and relevant regression coverage where appropriate.
- [ ] Public API, integration instructions, and changelog entries are updated when needed.
- [ ] Capture completion remains distinct from identity approval and proof of liveness.
- [ ] No real identity documents, face media, credentials, tokens, or other personal data are included.
- [ ] Third-party material has an identified origin and compatible license, if introduced.

Use the private reporting process in SECURITY.md for undisclosed vulnerabilities.
